nodes.label: EditorHost (src/editor/hosts.ts) passed to DatascratchEditor: attachments, [[ ]] links, cards, tags, task actions

EditorHost.fetchRemoteImage(url) (lib/remoteImage.ts) for images in pasted HTML (rich paste, D-52): asks own server POST /fetch-image { url }; non-200 (422 with reason, 429, network failure, 30 s timeout) → editor keeps the image as a link; received bytes go through regular uploadAttachment
nodes.rationale: CSP stays connect-src 'self' — the server fetches foreign images and rejects private networks, SVG, >20 MB and >15 s, so the web never connects to third-party hosts directly
